title: A2A Surface Audit v1

current_state.summary: A2A schemas exist (agent_card, task_card, delegation_receipt, task_lifecycle_event, promotion_readiness) but the implementation is skeletal. No transport server. No agent discovery mechanism. No capability advertisement. Agent Cards exist in schema but not in code. local_only: true means federation is not built. remote_federation_supported: false. Basic test coverage only (2 test files).
current_state.maturity: partial — schemas only; no transport; no discovery; no delegation runtime; no federation

a2a_doctrine: A2A is NOT local tool calling. It is inter-agent delegation across trust boundaries.
A2A is NOT allowed to bypass Rig Relay's mission governance.
A2A must be delegation with explicit trust tier, scope, budget, timeout, and evidence receipt.
Agent Cards must be content-light, signed or hash-pinned, and diffed on change.
Capability changes must be treated like permission changes — requiring review and producing evidence.
Delegated work must return structured evidence (receipts, artifacts, hashes), not just prose.
Remote agents are NOT trusted by default. Every remote agent has a trust tier that gates what it can do.
A2A delegation must not create side channels that bypass cockpit approval or MCP permission gating.

trust_tiers.name: Local Subagent (Trusted)
trust_tiers.allowed: full read access within workspace; tool execution within subagent tool profile; can propose patches (requires approval)
trust_tiers.forbidden: remote GitHub write; config changes; permission changes; admin operations
trust_tiers.verification: local process identity; subagent profile hash

trust_tiers.name: Local Orchestrator (Trusted)
trust_tiers.allowed: delegate tasks to subagents; read coordination state; schedule fleet operations; read mission state
trust_tiers.forbidden: remote mutation; subagent profile modification; workspace mutation outside mission scope
trust_tiers.verification: local process identity; orchestrator agent card hash

trust_tiers.name: Team Agent (Verified)
trust_tiers.allowed: receive delegated read-only tasks; return structured evidence; advertise capabilities via Agent Card
trust_tiers.forbidden: any mutation; access to other team agents' missions; access to admin surfaces
trust_tiers.verification: Agent Card hash must match known hash; Agent Card must be signed or pinned; recent capability diff must be reviewed

trust_tiers.name: Remote Verified Agent (Limited)
trust_tiers.allowed: receive read-only delegation with explicit scope; return content-light evidence within scope; advertise capabilities (read-only by default)
trust_tiers.forbidden: any mutation; workspace access; file system access; GitHub access; any operation that could mutate
trust_tiers.verification: Agent Card must be signed by recognized authority; capability must match advertised scope; delegation must be time-bound and scope-bound

trust_tiers.name: External Unverified Agent (Untrusted)
trust_tiers.allowed: receive narrowly-scoped query tasks with no state access; return content-light answers (prose only, no tool execution); no capability advertisement beyond query
trust_tiers.forbidden: any tool execution; any state access; any mutation; any workspace access; any GitHub access
trust_tiers.verification: Agent Card is informational only; no trust assumed; all input/output sanitized

agent_card_security: Agent Cards must be content-light: identity hash, capability list (names only, no implementation detail), trust tier, public key (if signed), hash pin, version, timestamp
Agent Card changes must be treated as security events: diff the card, produce evidence, require human review for capability additions
Agent Cards must be pinned by hash in delegation records: 'I delegated to agent X whose card hash was Y at time T'
Stale or expired Agent Cards must be rejected. TTL must be configurable (default: 24h for local, 1h for remote)
Capability advertisement must be explicit and narrow. No 'do anything' capability. No wildcard capabilities.
Agent Cards must never contain raw credentials, tokens, or secrets

a2a_interaction_with_ralph_orchestrator.ralph_role: Ralph (observe-only scanner) is not an A2A participant. Ralph produces projection inputs and mission candidates — it does not delegate to agents.
a2a_interaction_with_ralph_orchestrator.orchestrator_role: Orchestrator is the primary A2A delegator. It discovers subagents via A2A, delegates tasks with scope/budget/timeout, monitors progress, and aggregates results.
a2a_interaction_with_ralph_orchestrator.subagent_role: Subagents advertise capabilities via Agent Cards, receive delegated tasks within their trust tier, execute within mission scope, and return structured evidence.
a2a_interaction_with_ralph_orchestrator.hosted_team_role: In hosted/team mode, A2A delegation may span team members' agents. Per-member trust tiers apply. Delegation receipts provide cross-agent evidence.

a2a_tests_required: test_a2a_malicious_agent_card_detection — sabotage: submit Agent Card claiming unauthorized capabilities, verify blocked
test_a2a_stale_agent_card_rejection — sabotage: use expired Agent Card, verify delegation blocked
test_a2a_delegated_task_scope_enforcement — sabotage: delegated task attempts operation outside scope, verify blocked
test_a2a_trust_tier_enforcement — contract: tier 4 agent attempts tier 2 operation, verify blocked
test_a2a_delegation_timeout_enforcement — contract: delegated task exceeds timeout, verify cancelled
test_a2a_delegation_budget_exhaustion — substrate: delegated task exhausts budget, verify cancelled with receipt
test_a2a_capability_change_detection — adversarial: Agent Card changed between delegation and execution, verify detected
test_a2a_cross_agent_evidence_correlation — integration: correlate receipts from delegator and delegate, verify chain integrity
